title: Daedalus
summary: Raleigh names Daedalus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Daedalus, also printed Daedilus, who fled to Minos after slaying Attalus, made the Labyrinth, and escaped to Cocalus. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIII, §. V, sig. 266b
